orange-clove-zero-waste-shampoo-bar.title: Orange Clove - Zero Waste Shampoo Bar

detail.description:
Click HERE to build your bundle to save 20%!

Remember those sweet oranges studded with cloves in a gleaming glass bowl, by the fire, on a cozy winter night? The scent of this zero waste shampoo bar is the perfect blend of citrusy orange and spicy warm clove, a classic festive time smell.

A delightful and warming aroma that soothes the soul and warms the heart.


  • The therapeutic Orange Essential Oil coupled with Clove Essential Oil gives a fresh and lively warm fruity scent.
  • Shea Butter contains vitamin A & E with essential fatty acids which help to add moisture and shine to the hair.
  • Clove Essential Oil boosts blood circulation and promotes hair growth.

This seasonal and limited edition shampoo bar it has become a staple in our zero waste hair care line due to customer demand. Orange Clove Shampoo Bar is a great unisex scent that works fantastic for all hair types. Give it a place in your bathroom or offer it as a gift together with the conditioner bar - your hair and nose will be glad you did.

Handmade of coconut oil and cocoa butter based, this vegan shampoo bar will leave your hair soft, clean and nourished without stripping away your natural oils or hair color. The all-natural formula is color-safe.

Orange Clove plastic-free shampoo bar will last around 50+ washes. Each shampoo bar is 2.25 oz.

  • Handmade in USA
  • Silicone Free, Phthalate-free & Paraben Free
  • Palm-Oil Free
  • Color-Safe
  • Travel-Friendly Bar
  • Vegan
  • Package-Free Product
  • Plastic-Free Shipping

How to use it:

Lather this zero-waste shampoo bar over wet hair. Rinse with water and follow with conditioning bar. Take care to avoid eyes. If contact occurs, rinse with water. Store the bar out of the water stream on a dry soap dish.

Ingredients: Sodium-Coco Sulfate, Coconut Oil, Cocoa Butter, Orange Essential Oil, Shea Butter, Clove Essential Oil, Cocoa Powder, D-panthenol.

  • Suitable for All Hair Types: Whether your hair is straight, curly, oily, dry, or color-treated, our shampoo bars are safe and effective for everyone.

  • Gentle, Natural Ingredients: Free from harsh chemicals like parabens, phthalates, silicones, and animal products, our bars cleanse and nourish your hair without stripping away natural oils.

  • Eco-Friendly & Sustainable: Each bar can help reduce single-use plastic waste by potentially replacing up to two bottles of liquid shampoo or conditioner, allowing you to embrace a more sustainable lifestyle.

  • pH Balanced & Color-Safe: Formulated to maintain the natural pH balance of your scalp, our shampoo bars are gentle enough for daily use and won't fade or damage color-treated hair.

faq.heading: How to Use Our Shampoo Bar
faq.html:
1. Wet Your Hair: Begin by thoroughly wetting your hair from roots to ends.
  2. Create a Rich Lather: Rub the shampoo bar between your hands to build up a luxurious lather, or gently glide the bar directly onto your scalp in a "painting" motion.
  3. Massage In: Use your fingertips to massage the lather into your scalp and hair, promoting circulation and ensuring a deep cleanse.
  4. Rinse & Repeat: Rinse thoroughly.

faq.heading: Ingredients
faq.html:
Cocoa Butter deeply moisturizes hair, improving softness, shine, and manageability. It helps reduce breakage, tame frizz, and protect hair from damage, leaving it nourished and healthy.
 
Ingredients: Sodium-Coco Sulfate, Coconut Oil, Cocoa Butter, Orange Essential Oil, Shea Butter, Clove Essential Oil, D-panthenol.
